blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multilingual evaluations often score a model's opening yes or no, a token that also carries model and language answering conventions. We ask when different ways of eliciting and reading an answer recover the same judgment, and when they measure an answer habit. We collect 1.1 million replies from eight models in six languages on up to 105 moral vignettes, varying the question's form, the answer constraint, and the reading of the reply, token or sentence, in both wordings (the FAR-6 battery). Story-level judgment profiles converge across the tested readouts and question forms, except for the yes/no token after a negative interrogative read under a preset mapping: on the same replies, token and sentence profiles agree at a median r = 0.67 across cells, while sentence profiles agree with free-sentence profiles at 0.94, a known linguistic variability. With each language's story consensus removed, a model's profile is nearest to its own in another language for 39 of 48 model-language cells under proposition labels and 15 under free sentences, against 5 expected by chance. Particle, position, and named-term preferences follow their own patterns. A model can keep its judgment and change its yes: scoring that token requires establishing which proposition it affirms.
blocks.zh: 多语种评价往往得分一个模型的开局是或不是,这个标志也带有模型和语言答题的常规. 我们问,何时以不同的方式提出和阅读一个答案,何时恢复同样的判断,何时衡量答案习惯。 我们从八种六种语言的模型中收集了110万份关于最多105个道德问题的答复,这些答复改变了问题的形式、答案的制约以及两种措辞(FAR-6电池)中的答复、符号或句子的阅读。 故事级的判断剖面在经过测试的读出和提问表之间趋同,除了在预先设定的图中读到负面的询问后表示是/没有符号:在同一答复中,符号和句子剖面在中值 r = 0.67 的跨单元格中达成一致,而句子剖面在0.94 的免费判决剖面上表示同意,这是已知的语言变异. 随着每种语言的故事共识被移除,一个模型的剖面图在另一种语言中最接近于自己,在命题标签下的48个模型语言单元中的39个和自由句下的15个,而5个是偶然预期的. 粒子,位置,和命名期的偏好都遵循自己的规律. 一个模型可以保持其判断力,改变其是:强调这个符号需要确定它所申明的命题.

blocks.en: Language models are now asked for judgments, moral, social, and political, in many languages, and the usual instrument is a question with a fixed set of answers whose chosen option becomes a number: count yes as endorsement and no as rejection, then compare the number across models and languages ( Moore et al., 2024 ; Labat et al., 2026 ) , a number that is cheap, comparable, and looks language-neutral.
blocks.zh: 语言模型现在被要求在很多语言中进行判断,道德,社会和政治,通常的乐器是一个有固定的答案的问题,它所选择的选项变成一个数字:数是"是"作为认可,而不是"拒绝",然后比较各种模型和语言的数字(Moore等人,2024年;Labat等人,2026年),这个数字是便宜的,可比的,看起来语言中立的.

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, the role of the language cannot be assumed to be null.
A classic case is the negative question: an answer can address the polarity of the question or the truth of the state of affairs asked about, and which of the two yes and no pick depends on the language and, within a language, on the construction.
To “Do you not agree?”, an English speaker who does not agree may answer “Yes” or “No” and mean the same thing ( Goodhue and Wagner, 2018 ; Holmberg, 2016 ) ; a Japanese \cjkfont はい ( hai , “yes”) to a neutral negative question confirms the negative, that the speaker does not agree ( Kuno, 1973 ) ; German doch and French si exist to reject a negative antecedent ( Claus et al., 2017 ; Kameyama, 2013 ) .
The particle is an answering convention, not the judgment; a model trained on these languages inherits conventions of its own, such as preferring no, the second-listed option, or the term the question names.
A yes/no score therefore mixes the judgment with the way of answering, and the mixture can differ by language.
A model can keep its judgment and change its yes.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,不能认为该语言的作用是无效的。
一个典型的案例是负面的问题:一个答案可以解决问题极性或所问的状态的真相,两个是和不是选择中哪一个取决于语言,在一个语言内部,取决于构造.
“你不同意吗?” 一位不同意的英语演讲者可能回答“是”或“否”,意思相同(Goodhue and Wagner, 2018;Holmberg, 2016);一位日本人\cjkfont QQQ(hai, “是”)对一个中立的负面问题证实了这个负面问题,这位演讲者不同意(Kuno, 1973);德国道奇和法国西语存在拒绝一个负面的前奏(Claus等人, 2017;Kameyama, 2013)。
粒子是答答的常规,而不是判断;一个受过这些语言培训的模型继承了它自己的常规,比如偏好不,第二列的选项,或者问名一词.
因此,“是/否”的分数将判断与回答方式混为一谈,而混合物可能因语言而异。
一个模型可以保持判断力,改变它的"是".

blocks.en:
This is well described for human speakers but elusive in the evaluation of language models, where the form of the question, the constraint on the answer, and the rule that reads the reply are fixed by convenience rather than varied by design (§ 2 ).
We ask when different ways of eliciting and reading an answer recover the same judgment, and when they measure an answer habit instead.
We distinguish a judgment profile , the vector of story-level judgments of one model in one language under one readout, from an answer habit , a systematic preference in the way of answering.
The battery (§ 3 ) crosses the form of the question, including both wordings and the negative interrogative, the constraint on the answer, and the reading of the reply on the same stories in six languages for eight models, and reads the same replies twice.
blocks.zh:
对讲人来说,这是很好的描述,但在对语言模型的评价中是难以捉摸的,其中问题的形式,对答案的制约,以及阅读答案的规则都是由方便而不是按设计(§2)而确定的.
我们问,何时以不同方式提出和阅读一个答案会恢复同样的判断,何时衡量答案习惯。
我们区分一个判断特征, 一个模型在一种语言下 以一种语言进行的故事级判断的载体, 一个回答习惯,
电池(§3)横跨问题的形式,包括措辞和负面询问,对答案的制约,以及用6种语言为8个模型读取相同故事的回复,并两次读取相同的回复.

blocks.en:
We report four findings.
(1) Story-level judgment profiles converge across readouts and question forms, except for the yes/no token after a negative interrogative, which disagrees with the sentence it opens on the same replies (§ 4 , Figure 2 ).
(2) The same model in another language is closer than another model in the same language, and its consensus-removed profile identifies it across languages for 39 of 48 cells (§ 5 , Figure 3 ).
(3) Preferences for no, for the second-listed option, and for the named term have patterns of their own by model and language (§ 6 , Figure 4 ).
(4) After a negative interrogative, the token maps to its own sentence by construction, language, and model (§ 7 , Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们报告四项调查结果。
(1) 故事层面的判断概况在读出和提问表之间趋同,但负面审讯之后的 " 是 " / " 无 " 表示 " 除外,后者不同意在同一答复上所开的句子(第4节,图2)。
(2)在另一种语言中,同一模型比同一语言中的另一个模型更接近,其协商一致放弃的剖面图为48个单元格中的39个单元(§ 5,图3 )在语言中识别出来.
(3) 对 " 不 " 、 " 第二上市选项 " 和 " 指定术语 " 的首选按模式和语言具有各自的模式(第6节,图4)。
(4) 经过负面讯问后,按构造、语言和模型绘制其自己句子的符号图(第7节,图5)。

blocks.en: The study is motivated by how humans answer, but it measures models: a judgment measure must allow the same judgment to come with a different yes, and scoring the token requires establishing which proposition the model uses it to affirm (§ 8 ).
blocks.zh: 研究的动机是人类如何回答,但它衡量模型:判断措施必须允许同样的判断得出不同的是,而记号则需要确定模型用来确认的命题(第8节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Table 1 places the battery among the closest measurement studies: option order, labels, and prompt format move multiple-choice and benchmark answers ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) , and survey answers carry label, ordering, and acquiescence biases of their own, the last probed with negated-agreement questions whose ambiguity is noted but not resolved ( Dominguez-Olmedo et al., 2024 ; Tjuatja et al., 2024 ; Braun, 2025 ) .
Consistency studies vary paraphrase, topic, format, and translation ( Moore et al., 2024 ) , option order, symbols, and language on human-translated survey items ( Labat et al., 2026 ) , or the prompting language of moral-reasoning tests ( Khandelwal et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) ; none crosses the interrogative construction with the evaluative keying, and each reads its outputs once.
On what a score reads, much of the prompt sensitivity measured on English benchmarks with reference answers comes from rule-based scoring rather than from the generated answers ( Hua et al., 2025 ) ; a crossed English design separates the stance on moral dilemmas from order and label effects across three instruments ( Huang, 2026 ) ; and a desirability-matched format mitigates instruction-induced socially desirable responding on English personality items ( Okada et al., 2026 ) .
Model identity has been recovered by classifiers from psychometric profiles across two languages ( Sha et al., 2026 ) and from generated text ( Sun et al., 2025 ) .
The battery differs on three counts: question form and wording polarity are factors alongside the answer constraint in six languages; the same reply is read by a token rule and by a sentence judge; and identity is tested on consensus-removed profiles across six languages without a trained classifier.
blocks.zh:
表1将电池置于最接近的测量研究之列:选择顺序、标签和快速格式移动多选择和基准答案(郑等人,2024年;Pezeshkpour和Hruschka,2024年;Sclar等人,2024年),以及调查答案带有自己标签、命令和默认偏差,这是最后一个带有否定协议问题的调查,其模糊性已注意到但未解决(Dominguez-Olmedo等人,2024年;Tjuatja等人,2024年;Broun,2025年)。
一致性研究有多种说法、专题、格式和翻译(Moore等人,2024年),选择顺序、符号和人类翻译调查项目的语言(Labat等人,2026年),或道德推理测试的诱导语言(Khandelwal等人,2024年;Agarwal等人,2024年),没有一种与评价键法交叉的诘问结构,而且每个都读过一次其产出。
关于一个分数的读数,用参考答案衡量的英语基准的快速灵敏度大多来自基于规则的分数而不是生成的答案(Hua等人,2025年);跨度的英语设计将道德困境的立场与三种仪器的秩序和标签效果区分开来(黄,2026年);可取的配对格式减轻了指令引发的社会对英语人格项目的反应(Okada等人,2026年).
分类人员从两种语言的心理测量特征(Sha等人,2026年)和生成的文本(Sun等人,2025年)中恢复了模型身份。
问题形式和措辞的两极性与六种语言的答案制约是不同的因素;同一答复由象征性规则和一个句子法官阅读;身份在6种语言的共识解析图上测试,没有经过训练的分类器。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The battery (FAR-6). One story is asked through concept pairs, question forms, and answer constraints, each question in both wordings, so that a judgment can be separated from a preference for a wording or a position. The reply is read twice, by a fixed decoder on its opening and by a sentence judge of the whole sentence; the example shows the two readings disagreeing on one reply to a negative interrogative. The form labels F1–F4 and the constraint names are used in the figures throughout.
blocks.zh: 图 1:电池(FAR-6). 一个故事通过概念对联,提问形式,回答制约,每个问题在两种措辞中都存在,这样判断就可以从偏好措辞或立场中分离出来. 复文在开篇时由固定的解码员和整句的句子裁判员阅读两次;例子显示两个读数在一次回答否定的询问时有分歧. 表格标签为F1–F4,限制名称在整个数字中使用。

blocks.en:
The battery (FAR-6; Figure 1 ) varies three things about a yes/no question put to a model.
The first is the form of the question, covering the general ways of posing one.
A plain polar question (“Was what Finn did wrong?”) is the default; the negative interrogative (“Wasn’t what Finn did wrong?”) negates it, the construction on which answer systems differ; the alternative question lists both terms (“wrong or right?”); and the or-not question (“…, or not?”) is natural in some of our languages and marked in others (Appendix A3 ).
The second is the answer constraint , the standard ways of requesting a reply, from the least to the most constrained: a free sentence, a sentence that starts with a verdict word, a sentence that starts with yes or no (with language-specific particles), and one letter that stands for an explicit proposition, with both letter orders presented (Appendix A1 ).
The third is the reading : the opening token or letter, read by a fixed rule, or the whole sentence, read by a judge; each form and each constraint is asked about the same stories in six languages and in both wordings of every question.
blocks.zh:
电池(FAR-6;图1)在对模型提出“是”/“否”问题方面有三点不同。
第一是问题的形式,包括提出问题的一般方式。
一个纯粹的极性问题(“芬恩做了什么错? ”)是默认的;负面的询问(“芬恩做了什么错?”)否定了它,否定了答案系统不同的结构;备选问题列出了两个术语(“错误还是正确?” );或者非问题(“...,还是?”)在我们的一些语言中是自然的,在另一些语言中是标记的(附录A3)。
第二种是回答约束,要求回答的标准方式,从最少到最受限制:句子自由,句子以判决词开头,句子以是或否开头(带有特定语言的粒子),以及一个代表明确命题的字母,同时提出两个字母命令(附录A1).
第三句是读 : 开元符或信,用固定规则读,或全句,由法官读;每种形式和每一种约束,都以六种语言和每题的两种措辞询问相同的故事.

blocks.en:
The stories combine 85 Moral Foundations Vignettes with published wrongness ratings ( Clifford et al., 2015 ) and 20 authored stories, spanning acceptable, contested, and violation cases.
English, Chinese, German, and Japanese cover up to 105 stories, Korean and French 45.
Language-specific concept pairs such as wrong/right and oppose/support express opposing evaluations of the act (Appendix A8 ); keying denotes which term the question names.
Concept pair, keying, option order, and repetition (a subset of prompts receives three independent generations) stay separate throughout (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
故事结合了85个道德基金会(Vignettes)与已公布的错误评级(Clifford等人,2015年)和20个编剧故事,跨越了可接受的,有争议的,以及侵权案件.
英语,汉语,德语,日语封面多达105个故事,朝鲜语和法语45个故事.
语言特定的概念对称,如错误/正确,反对/支持表达对行为的对立评价(Appendix A8);按键表示问题名称的哪个词.
概念配对、按键、选项顺序和重复(一个子集的提示接收三个独立代)在整个过程中保持独立(表2)。

blocks.en:
A readout combines a question form, answer constraint, and reading; a cell combines a model and a language.
The fixed token rule reads yes as affirming the term named in the question and no as its opposite, counting German doch and French si with yes.
After a negative interrogative this is the polarity-based mapping of the linguistic literature, one human answer system among others, which we retain as the hypothesis to be tested against the sentence it opens (§ 7 ).
The verdict word is read by a fixed rule extended in four stated ways (Appendix A11 ; the figures label the rules R and R+).
The sentence judge (Claude Sonnet 5, one uniform prompt) instead codes whether the reply asserts the reference proposition, asserts its opposite, takes both sides or conditions, or takes no position (P and not-P in the figures); only the first two readings are decisive and enter the shares.
blocks.zh:
一个读出结合了提问形式,回答约束,读取;一个单元格结合了模型和语言.
固定的标志性规则是肯定的,
经过负面的盘问后,这是基于极性对语言文学的映射,一个人类的答案系统等等,我们保留这个假设,作为对照它所打开的句子进行测试(§7).
判决词通过四种说明方式延伸的固定规则(Appendix A11;标注规则R和R+的数字)来读取.
句子判官(Claude Sonnet 5,一个统一的即时)代之以代码,即答复是否坚持参考命题,断言相反,是否采取双方或条件,或者不采取立场(数字中为P而非P);只有前两读是决定性的,输入股份.

We compare profiles on their common stories through three quantities: story-level r r , their Pearson correlation; residual-profile r r , the same correlation after removing each language’s story consensus over models and each model’s mean, which asks whether a model’s departures from its peers stay distinctive; and mean | Δ | \lvert\Delta\rvert , the mean absolute difference between corresponding story scores, which retains changes in individual judgments that a high correlation can conceal.
Class means use 95% story-bootstrap intervals with models and languages fixed, and class differences the same resampled stories.

blocks.en:
The battery holds 1,104,574 replies, 839,230 of them in the analyzed answer constraints; the rest are additional conditions and a control stratum excluded from all analyses, and not every combination of form and constraint is run.
We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, GPT-6 luna, GPT-6.1 sol, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Qwen3.8-27B, and Mistral Medium 3.5 (prompts, settings, and coverage in Appendices A1 and A2 ).
Every free and verdict-first reply has a judged sentence, as does every yes/no-first reply to the plain question and to the negative interrogative; about 4% of the other token and label replies are judged (Appendix A2 ).
Two other judge models agree with the sentence reference on 95.5% and 97.2% of audited replies, native readers on 95.5% of 400 replies in four languages with no opposite decisive label, and repeated runs of the same judge on 96.3% and 97.7% of two sets of 300 identical prompts (Table 7 ).

电池有1,104,574份答复,其中839,230份在分析的解答限制中;其余是附加条件和控制层,被排除在所有分析之外,不是所有形式和制约的组合。
我们评价Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 5、Claude Opus 5、GPT-6 luna、GPT-6.1 sol、双子座3.1 Flash-Lite、Qune3.8-27B和Mistral Media 3.5(时机、设置和附录A1和A2的覆盖范围)。
每一份自由的和判决的第一答复都有一个经过评判的句子,对简单问题和负面审讯的每一份是/不是第一次答复也是一样;对其他信条和标签答复的大约4%得到评判(附录A2)。
另有两个法官模型同意关于95.5%和97.2%的经审计答复的句子,400份答复中有95.5%的本地读者没有相反的决定性标签,同一法官在两套300个相同的提示中重复了96.3%和97.7%(表7)。

blocks.en:
Two readouts of one cell can differ for three reasons: sampling variability across repeated generations, which more draws reduce (Appendix A9 ); systematic effects of wording, keying, order, and constraint, which the balanced design averages over and § 6 measures one by one; and the mapping from an opening token to a proposition, which no amount of sampling can settle, because the same yes accompanies opposite propositions in different constructions.
Reading the same replies twice isolates the third: both readings of the same replies with identical weights hold the generated text fixed, so a difference lies in the reading; comparing those sentences with free sentences on the same stories then checks whether the constraint changed the profile.
blocks.zh:
一个单元格的两种读出可以有三种原因: 重复代的采样变异性,更多的抽取减少(附录A9); 措辞,按键,顺序和约束的系统性影响,均衡设计平均值和§6的量度逐一; 从开标到一个命题的映射,没有多少采样可以解决,因为同样的是和不同构造中的相反命题相伴.
读同一份答复两次孤立了第三份:两份具有相同权重的同一份答复的读数都固定了生成的文本,所以不同之处在于读数;将这些句子与同一故事上的免费句子进行比较,然后检查约束是否改变了配置.

blocks.en: 4 Which readouts converge
blocks.zh: 页:1 哪个读出汇合

blocks.en: Figure 2 a gives each comparison’s median over the 48 cells and its 10–90% range on the stories common to the compared readouts (Appendix A3 ).
blocks.zh: 图2 a给出了48个单元格的每个比较的中位数,以及比较读出时常见故事的10-90%的范围(附录A3)。

blocks.en:
The plotted readout pairs converge except for those red rows, with median story-level r r at least 0.90.
Under plain questions, free sentences agree with proposition labels at 0.92 and with verdict-first sentences at 0.93; the comparisons across question forms preserve the profile likewise (Table 3 ).
Median residual correlations among the convergent pairs range from 0.46 to 0.93: agreement retains how individual models depart from the consensus.
blocks.zh:
规划的读数对除了那些红线外,都汇合在一起,故事中位数为r至少0.90.
在普通问题下,自由句与命题标签一致,为0.92,判决第一句为0.93;对问题表格的比较同样保留了概况(表3)。
趋同方对之间的中间残余关联介于0.46至0.93之间:协议保留单个模式如何偏离共识。

blocks.en:
Under the fixed rule, the negative-interrogative token changes that picture: against the plain-question token its median story-level correlation falls to 0.73, with mean absolute story difference 0.22 and some cells below zero.
On the same 71,282 replies with both readings decisive (§ 3 ), the token and sentence profiles agree at 0.67, with absolute difference 0.25, whereas the profiles of those judged sentences agree with free-sentence profiles from other replies on common stories at 0.94 (absolute difference 0.07); the same double reading of the plain-question replies agrees at 0.99 with absolute difference 0.02.
Requiring a yes/no opening still produces sentences whose story profiles reproduce the free-sentence profile; the change lies in the opening’s mapping to its sentence.
blocks.zh:
在固定规则下,负诘签符号会改变该图片:相对于平庸问题符号,其故事层次的中位关系下降到0.73,其中平均绝对故事差0.22,一些单元格低于零.
在同样71 282份答复中,字面和句子说明书都具有决定性(第3节),0.67份一致,绝对差异0.25份,而经判断的句子说明书则与其他关于共同故事的答复中的自由判决说明书一致,0.94份(绝对差异0.07份);同样对普通问题答复的双重解读为0.99份,绝对差异0.02。
要求是/否的开口仍然会产生句子,其故事简介转载了自由判决的简介;变化在于开口时的图解。

blocks.en:
Reply-level disagreement supports this reading without aggregation (Figure 2 b): among replies with both readings decisive, mean disagreement across cells rises from 3.3% for plain-question yes/no-first replies to 31.3% after a negative interrogative.
A targeted audit by three judge configurations at high reasoning effort upholds the sentence reading in 93–96% of the conflicting negative-interrogative replies but in only about half of the conflicting plain-question replies (Appendix A1 ), so the plain-question rate partly reflects the judge.
Verdict openings also depart more under negation; proposition letters do not (Appendix A11 ).
blocks.zh:
答复层面的分歧支持这种不汇总的解读(图2b):在两种有决定性解读的回复中,不同单元格之间的差额从3.3%的纯问题是/不是第一次回复上升到31.3%的负面询问后。
三位法官组合在高推理努力下进行的定向审计,维持了93-96%的负面审讯答复中的句子,但在大约一半的矛盾的简单问题答复中(附录A1),所以简单提问率部分反映了法官。
判决的开口也比否定差得多;命题字母没有(附录A11 .

blocks.en: Figure 3: Model identity across languages. (a) Class means with 95% story-bootstrap intervals and pair ranges, labels filled and free sentences hollow, with the nearest-neighbor counts. (b) Per-model language-pair values, filled for story-level r r and hollow for residual r r , with the number of the model’s six language cells whose nearest other cell is the same model (residual r r , labels). (c) Between-cell story-level correlations on common stories and (d) residual-profile correlations, cells grouped by model; (e) and (f) the same matrices grouped by language: the same-model blocks on the diagonal of (d) stand out, the same-language blocks on the diagonal of (f) do not; the counts in (a) and (b), not the heat maps, identify a model.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Three answer habits under plain questions (top) and negative interrogatives (bottom). Model means over languages use hollow markers for plain questions and filled markers for negative interrogatives; ticks mark languages. The second-listed preference remains similar, named-term pull approaches zero, and token keying bias scatters and changes sign.
blocks.zh: 图4:普通问题(顶级)和负面审讯(底级)下的三种回答习惯. 模型指语言之上使用空心标记来表示简单的问题,填充标记来表示负面的询问;勾选标记语言. 第二列的偏好仍然是相似的,命名期的拉力接近零,象征性的按键偏差散开和变化标志.

blocks.en: 5 Model identity across languages
blocks.zh: 5 各语文的示范身份

blocks.en:
With the readouts agreeing except where noted, profiles can be compared across models and languages: is the same model in another language closer than another model in the same language?
Figure 3 compares proposition-label profiles under plain questions over pairs of model–language cells, grouped by what changes: language, model, or both.
blocks.zh:
如果读者同意,但有注明的除外,则可以对模型和语言的配置进行比较:同一模型在另一种语言中是否比同一语言中的另一个模型更接近?
图3将平面问题下的命题标签配置图比对成对的模型-语言单元格,按以下变化分类:语言、模型或两者。

blocks.en:
The most direct test treats the 48 cells (eight models in six languages) as unlabeled profiles and asks which other cell each one resembles most (Table 6 ).
Under residual r r , a cell’s nearest neighbor is another language of the same model for 39 of 48 proposition-label cells (per model in Figure 3 b), against 5 under a uniform-random-neighbor benchmark that gives each of the 47 other cells equal probability and ignores the language structure of the cells; under story-level r r the count is 25, and under mean | Δ | \lvert\Delta\rvert it is 30.
blocks.zh:
最直接的测试将48个单元格(6种语言的8个模型)作为无标签的剖面图处理,并询问其他哪个单元格彼此最相似(表6 ).
在剩余 r 下,一个单元格的近邻是48个命题标签单元格中的39个(图3b中的每个模型)的同一模式的另一种语言,相对于一个统一-随机-邻基准下的5个,该基准给予其他47个单元格中的每一个都相等的概率,忽略了单元格的语言结构;在故事层 r 下,计数为25,在平均值 QQ\\\\ lvert\ Delta翻转它30。

blocks.en:
The same-model class has higher mean story-level correlation than the same-language class, 0.88 against 0.81, and a mean absolute story difference of 0.10 against 0.15; both contrasts have joint bootstrap intervals that exclude zero ( + 0.075 +0.075 [0.047, 0.096] and − 0.052 -0.052 [ − 0.065 -0.065 , − 0.040 -0.040 ]).
Story-level r r is dominated by structure every cell shares (violations high, acceptable stories low), which keeps the gap modest.
Within one story group the gap widens where models disagree, 0.79 against 0.69 on acceptable stories and 0.70 against 0.62 on contested stories, and vanishes on violations (0.43 against 0.46), where every cell condemns and little remains to tell models apart (Appendix A10 ).
blocks.zh:
同型类相比,平均故事层次的相关性更高,为0.88对0.81,平均绝对故事差异为0.10对0.15;两种对比均具有排除0(+0.075+0.075[0.047,0.096]和−0.052[−0.065-0.065,−0.040-0.040])的联合靴间隔.
故事层r r 以结构为主,每个细胞共享(违反高,可接受故事低),使缺口保持适度.
在一个故事组中,在模型有分歧的地方差距扩大,在可接受的故事上,0.79对0.69,在有争议的故事上,0.70对0.62,在侵权问题上则消失(0.43对0.46),每个单元都谴责侵权行为,几乎没有留下什么可以区分模型(附录A10)。

blocks.en: The same model across languages retains a mean residual correlation of 0.56; within-language centering couples the different-model residuals, so their negative mean is a constrained reference, and the informative result is the positive same-model association.
blocks.zh: 不同语言的同一模型保留了0.56的中间残余关系;语言中枢的夫妇是不同模型的残余,因此他们的负平均值是受限的引用,信息化的结果是同模型的正面关联.

blocks.en:
The strength of that signature differs across models and language pairs (Figure 3 b).
Residual correlations span 0.69–0.97 for sol against 0.14–0.50 for Qwen and about zero to 0.54 for luna.
Under free sentences the residual profiles identify the model for 15 of 48 cells, against 39 under proposition labels.
One candidate explanation is granularity: free-sentence story scores sit at an endpoint for 81% of model–language–story observations against 49% for labels (Appendix A9 ), leaving less graded structure to carry a model’s departures; the comparison does not establish this.
A model thus retains a distinctive judgment profile across languages, with story-level changes of 0.10 (labels) and 0.07 (free sentences) per story.
blocks.zh:
这种签名的强度因模型和语言对而异(图3b)。
剩余关联度为0.69-0.97,昆文为0.14-0.50,露娜约为0-0.54。
在自由句下,剩余剖面可确定48个单元格中的15个单元格的模型,而在命题标签下为39个。
一个候选解释是颗粒性:自由判决故事得分占模型-语言-故事观察的81%,而标签(Apendix A9)为49%,留下的分级结构较少,以背负模型的离去;比较并不能证明这一点。
因此,模型保留了不同语言的独特判断特征,故事层次的变化为每个故事0.10(标签)和0.07(自由句).

(b) Polarity shares by wording and model: blue is polarity, red truth/agreement, white an even split. (c) Corresponding constructions across languages (negated attitude verb, negated evaluative adjective, negated evaluative verb; wordings in Table 5 ); bars give model means and markers individual models. Appendix A5 gives the direction split.
blocks.zh: 图5 负面审讯令牌,给出句子. (a) 文章-判决组合对绘图作了界定。 (b) 按措辞和模式划分的极性份额:蓝色为极性,红色为真/协议,白色为平分。 (c) 各种语言的对应构思(消极态度动词、否定评价形容词、否定评价动词;表5中的措辞);条条给出模型手段并标注单个模型。 附录A5给出方向划分.

blocks.en: 6 Answer habits and their change under negation
blocks.zh: 6 回答习惯及其在否定下的变化

blocks.en:
We now return to the constrained readouts, the yes/no token under the plain question and the proposition letter, whose story profiles converge with the sentence profile while measurable answering preferences remain, attached to the question’s wording or option order rather than to the story.
We measure three such habits on the same reference proposition.
Yes/no keying bias is b b , half the difference between the shares under the two wordings (negative for a preference for no; the sign is kept when the named term sits inside negation).
Second-listed preference, measured on proposition-label choices, is half the difference between choosing the second- and the first-listed proposition.
Named-term pull, a term of ours for the same choices, is the preference for the proposition that contains the term the question names, a lexical echo of the question (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们现在回到受限制的读数、简单问题下的是/否符号和命题字母,其故事简介与句子简介一致,而可测量的答案偏好依然存在,附于问题的措辞或选择顺序而不是故事。
我们根据同样的参考建议衡量三种这种习惯。
是/ 没有键入偏差是 b b , 即两种措辞下股份差异的一半(否定偏好为 否;当名词坐落于否定中时,符号保留).
以命题-标签选择来衡量的第二上市偏好,是选择第二上市命题和第一上市命题的一半区别.
命名-term拉(英語:named-term pull),是"我们"用于相同选择的一个术语,是偏爱包含问题名称这一术语的命题,即问题的一个词汇回声(图4 ).

blocks.en: Yes/no keying bias favors no in every plain-question cell, averaging − 0.11 -0.11 , but its magnitude belongs to a model–language combination: the interaction accounts for 0.56 of the cell-mean matrix’s variance (cells in Appendix A4 ).
blocks.zh: 是/ 没有键入偏差在每一个纯问题单元格中都是没有的,平均为 − 0.11 - 0.11,但其大小属于模式 - 语言组合:相互作用占单元格-正矩阵差异的0.56(附录A4中的单元格)。

blocks.en:
Second-listed preference averages + 0.05 +0.05 and follows the model more closely; named-term pull is positive in every plain-question cell, averaging + 0.08 +0.08 (Table 4 ).
Position balance and opposing wordings therefore address distinct preferences: reversing the options alone leaves the named-term association free to move the answer (Appendix A4 ).
blocks.zh:
第二列出的偏好平均值为+0.05+0.05,并更紧密地跟随模型;每个纯问题单元格的命名周期拉力为正数,平均值为+0.08+0.08(表4).
因此,立场平衡和对立措辞涉及不同的偏好:仅靠逆转选项就可以让名称名称的关联自由移动答案(附录A4)。

blocks.en:
Negation separates the habits’ trajectories (hollow against filled markers): second-listed preference remains similar, named-term pull approaches zero, and the fixed reading of the yes/no opening changes the sign of b b in 19 of the 48 cells.
The changing sign points to the token’s mapping to its sentence.
blocks.zh:
Negation将习惯的轨迹区分开来(hollow相对于填充的标记):第二列的偏好仍然相似,命名的拉法接近0,对"是/否"开口的固定读数会改变48个单元格中19个b的符号.
改变的标志指向该标志的句子。

blocks.en: 7 What the negative-interrogative token encodes
blocks.zh: 页:1 什么负面的审讯令牌编码

blocks.en:
Figure 5 a illustrates the alternatives for “Do you not agree with what X did?”: under the polarity mapping , yes accompanies “I agree”; under the truth/agreement mapping , yes accompanies “I do not agree.”
The polarity share is the fraction of usable particle replies following the former mapping given their judged sentence (selection in Appendix A2 ).
blocks.zh:
图5a说明了“你是否同意X做了什么?” “我同意”;“我不同意”。 “
极性份额是指在前一次测绘之后,根据判断的句子(附录A2中的选择),可用粒子答复的一小部分。

blocks.en: Judged free sentences under negative interrogatives have median story-level correlation 0.94 with their plain-question counterparts, and against the published English human reference the token’s mean correlation falls from 0.60 to 0.25 while the sentence and label associations remain similar (Appendix A6 ).
blocks.zh: 在负面审讯下判断的自由句子与平庸的对等词有中位故事层次的关联0.94,而相对于出版的英文人文参考词,信使的平均关联从0.60降至0.25,而句子和标签关联仍然相似(附录A6 ).

blocks.en:
For Japanese \cjkfont 反対しないんですか ( hantai shinai n desu ka , “Do you not oppose?”), Sonnet, Opus, and Qwen favor polarity, while Haiku, luna, and Mistral favor truth/agreement.
In English, “Do you not agree / oppose?” has mean polarity share 0.22 against 0.99 for “Don’t you think?” (Appendix A5 ).
blocks.zh:
对于日语\cjkfont QQ(hantai shinai n desu ka, “你不反对吗?”), Sonnet, Opus, 和Quen 倾向于极性,而 Haiku, Luna, 和 Mistral 则倾向于真理/协议.
在英语中, “你不同意/反对吗? ” 意味着极性占0.22比0.99, (附录A5).

blocks.en: Families of corresponding constructions, defined from the prompts before inspecting their values (Figure 5 c), show the negated evaluative adjective ranging from mean polarity shares 0.97 in English and 0.91 in French to 0.21 in Chinese (wordings and support in Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在检查其值之前从提示中定义的相应构思的家族(图5 c),显示了否定的评价形容词,从英语中平均极性占0.97,法语中平均极性占0.91,到中文中0.21(表5中的词句和支持)不等.

blocks.en:
Human linguistics distinguishes a few answer systems for negative questions: polarity-based ones, in which yes affirms the term the question names; truth- or agreement-based ones, in which yes confirms the negative proposition; and mixed ones with a dedicated reversal particle such as German doch or French si ( Holmberg, 2016 ; Claus et al., 2017 ; Kameyama, 2013 ) .
English is usually placed in the first group and Japanese in the second ( Kuno, 1973 ) , and in Mandarin \cjkfont 是/ \cjkfont 不 ( shì / bù ) track the answerer’s opinion against the polarity of the question’s main point ( Lu, 2002 ) ; our two mappings operationalize the first two systems.
Speakers are less clear-cut than the classification, with both answers attested in one language depending on construction and context ( Goodhue and Wagner, 2018 ; Park, 2023 ) ; the models show the same complexity.
Appendix A7 sets the model mappings beside the literature and dialogue corpora; a matched human study is future work.
We therefore identify the mapping from the model’s own sentence: a changed yes can reflect a changed way of relating to a negative question while the sentence preserves the judgment.
blocks.zh:
人类语言学区分了几个对负面问题的答案系统:极性-基于极性-基于极性-基于极性-基于极性-基于对问名的肯定;基于真理或基于协议-基于真理-基于对否定命题的肯定;以及具有德国doch或法国si等专用反转粒子的混合(Holmberg, 2016; Claus et al., 2017; Kameyama, 2013).
英语通常排在第一组,日语排在第二组(Kuno,1973年),普通话中为\cjkfont $102. /\cjkfont prit(shì/bù) 追踪回答者对问题主点极性的看法(Lu,2002年);我们两幅地图将前两个系统运行.
发言者比分类更清晰,两种答案都根据构造和上下文以一种语言证明(Goodhue和Wagner,2018年;Park,2023年);模型显示同样的复杂性.
附录A7设定了文学和对话公司旁边的模型映射;对应的人类研究是未来的工作.
因此,我们从模型本身的句子中找出地图:改变 " 是 " 可以反映与负面问题有关的改变方式,而句子则保留判断力。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion and recommendations
blocks.zh: 8 讨论和建议

blocks.en:
Read the sentence, or balance proposition labels across opposing wordings and orders; both reproduce the story profile.
Report keying bias beside a yes/no score; the preference for no varies by model and language.
Do not score the opening token after a negative interrogative as a judgment.
A judgment measure must allow the same judgment to come with a different yes.
blocks.zh:
阅读句子,或者在对立的措辞和命令之间平衡命题标签;两者都转载故事简介.
报告在 " 是/否 " 分数之外按键偏差;倾向于不因模式和语言而异。
在作为判决的负面审讯后,不要给开封标志打分。
判决措施必须允许同一判决产生不同的 " 是 " 。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Same-model comparisons retain per-story differences, and residual structure reproduces with substantial variation across models and language pairs; the model signature is sharper under proposition labels than under free sentences.
Medians over cells for readout comparisons and class means over cell pairs for identity comparisons summarize different units.
blocks.zh:
同型模型比较保留了每层差异,残余结构复制,在模型和语言对位之间有很大差异;模型签名在命题标签下比在自由句下更尖锐.
用于读出比较和类的单元格上的介质,是指用于身份比较的单元格对上的介质,总结不同的单位.

blocks.en:
Korean and French contain fewer stories.
Undecided sentences that take both sides, add conditions, or take no position are excluded from decisive shares, and the other token and label conditions are judged on a sample.
The English, Chinese, German, and Japanese instruments were reviewed by native readers; the Korean and French instruments and story renderings were not (Appendix A1 ).
blocks.zh:
韩语和法语中包含的故事较少.
未决定的句子,如果采取双方,附加条件,或者不采取任何立场,则被排除在决定性的股份之外,其他的符号和标签条件则按样本判断.
英文、中文、德文和日文的乐器都由本地读者审查;韩文和法文的乐器和故事渲染没有(附录A1)。

blocks.en:
The sentence judge is one model, supported by two other judge models, a targeted audit at higher reasoning effort, test–retest checks, and native-reader labels on 100 replies per language in Chinese, English, German, and Japanese; Korean and French replies have no human labels, and the audited negative-interrogative yes/no-first strata hold 19–33 replies per language.
These audits measure agreement between judgment procedures, leaving shared labeling biases possible; on plain-question replies where token and sentence conflict, stronger judges side with the token about half the time.
blocks.zh:
句子评委是一个模型,由另外两个评委模型支持,针对更高推理努力的定向审计,测试-复试检查,以及每个语言的中文,英文,德文,日文100个回复的本土阅读者标签;韩文和法文回复没有人类标签,被审计的负面询问是/否第一层持有19–33个回复.
这些审计对判决程序之间的一致进行衡量,从而有可能造成共同的偏见;在平庸的回答中,如果象征性的和句子有冲突,则大约一半时间里更强大的法官会站在象征性一边。

blocks.en:
The models and languages are fixed, and intervals resample stories rather than model or language populations.
The measurements concern the forms, constraints, reading rules, and wordings represented in the battery.
The construction groups retain available language-specific wordings and therefore do not isolate syntax from every lexical or pragmatic difference.
blocks.zh:
模型和语言是固定的,间隔重现故事而不是模型或语言群.
测量涉及电池中的形式、限制、阅读规则和措辞。
建筑组保留了可用的特定语言措辞,因此不会将语法与每个词汇或实用差异相分离.

blocks.en:
Published MFV ratings provide an English reference set used across languages.
The dialogue corpora span different registers and collection settings from the model prompts and provide linguistic background, without establishing that models match or mismatch speakers; no human study on the same stories exists.
blocks.zh:
已公布的MFV收视率提供了跨语言使用的英文参考集.
对话公司横跨模型的不同登记册和收集设置,提供语言背景,但不确定模型匹配或不匹配的演讲者;没有关于相同故事的人类研究。

blocks.en: s s and b b are an operational decomposition, not pure judgment and pure bias; the judge is a reference rather than ground truth; and cross-language identifiability is a property of the measured profiles, not evidence of a language-free internal state.
blocks.zh: ss和bb是一种操作性的分解,不是纯粹的判断和纯粹的偏执;法官是参考而非地面的真理;跨语言的可识别性是测量剖面的属性,而不是无语言的内部状态的证据.

blocks.en: Appendix A1 Prompt construction, model settings, and judging
blocks.zh: 附录A1 快速构造、模型设置和判断

blocks.en: Table 2: The battery (FAR-6). Coverage pools decisive replies over generated replies in the analyzed constraints; the yes/no-token denominator excludes alternative questions, whose token is unreadable by design. Combinations have different supports.
blocks.zh: 表2:电池(FAR-6)。 覆盖范围汇集了决定性的答复,超过了分析的制约因素中产生的答复;是/否分母排除了其他问题,这些问题的标语是设计上无法读懂的。 组合有不同的支持.

blocks.en: The 105 stories are 85 Moral Foundations Vignettes, including 16 social-norm controls, and 20 authored stories. The three story groups (acceptable 26, contested 46, violation 33) were fixed before any model was run, from the published wrongness ratings and the authored design; Korean and French use 45 stories, 15 per group. Each story and language has four machine renderings (two translation services and two language models), of which two enter the battery and rotate across the story’s two concept-pair blocks; an automatic screen (name, length, script, back-translation, cross-engine outlier) flagged 184 renderings, and 71 were held out after a reading. Native readers reviewed the English, Chinese, and German instruments (an author) and the Japanese instrument (a collaborator); the Korean and French instruments and renderings had no native review. Question templates and instructions were written per language, never translated. The design records each item’s story group, language, rendering, concept pair, question form, named term, answer constraint, option order, and repeat, with the exact prompt text and the letter or particle mapping. Figure A8 gives the language-specific evaluative terms, while Figure 5 and Table 5 give the negative-interrogative wordings.
blocks.zh: 105个故事是85个道德基金会Vignettes,包括16个社会规范控制,20个编剧故事. 三个故事组(可接受26个,质疑46个,侵权33个)在任何模型运行之前都是固定的,从已发布的错误评级和作者设计;韩语和法语使用45个故事,每组15个. 每个故事和语言都有四个机器渲染(两个翻译服务和两个语言模型),其中两个进入电池并旋转过故事的两个概念绘画块;一个自动屏幕(名称,长度,脚本,反翻译,跨引擎输出)标注了184个渲染,71个在读完后被搁置. 土著读者回顾了英文、中文和德国的乐器(作者)和日本的乐器(合作者);韩文和法文的乐器和渲染没有本土评论。 问题模板和指示是按语言编写的,从未翻译过。 设计中记录了每个项目的故事组,语言,渲染,概念配对,提问表,命名名词,答题约束,选项顺序,以及重复,并有准确的即时文字和字母或粒子映射. 图A8给出了特定语言的评价术语,而图5和表5给出了负面的询问措辞.

blocks.en: Every free and verdict-first reply has a judged sentence, as does every yes/no-first reply to the plain question and to the negative interrogative (77,952 each). For the other yes/no-first and proposition-label conditions a seeded sample is judged; Table 7 gives the counts per form.
blocks.zh: 每项自由的和判决的第一答复都有判决,对简单问题和负面审讯(各77 952人)的每一份是/不是第一次答复也有判决。 对于其他 " 是/否 " 和 " 命题标签 " 条件,则对种子样本进行判断;表7列出每个表格的计数。

blocks.en: Shares are computed per item over decisive replies, averaged over repeated generations within the item, then over option orders with equal weight, combined over the two keyings into s s and b b , and averaged over concept pairs into story scores. Two cells are compared on their common stories when at least eight exist. Residual profiles subtract, within each language, the story mean over models and then each cell’s mean, and are compared on stories with common-model support; a cell without variance on the common support is skipped. Nearest neighbors are taken among the 47 other cells; no ties occurred in the reported readouts. Class intervals come from 300 bootstrap resamples of stories with a fixed seed, every cell recomputed per draw including the residual centering; class differences use the same draws.
blocks.zh: 在决定性答复中,每个项目的份额是按项目内数代数计算的,然后按同等权重的选项顺序计算,在两个键上合并为s和bb,在概念对数中平均为故事分数。 在至少存在8个时,在他们共同的故事上比较两个单元格。 在每种语言中,残存的剖面图减去了故事对模型的表示,然后是每个单元格的表示,然后在有共同模型支持的故事上进行比较;在共同支持上没有差异的单元格被跳过。 在其他47个牢房中,最接近的邻居被带走;在报告的读取中,没有任何联系。 类间隔来自有固定种子的故事的300个靴子的复刻本,每个单元格重算每幅图,包括剩余中线;类差异使用相同的图.

blocks.en: The inventory distinguishes constructions because response interpretation depends on negation placement and context as well as language ( Romero and Han, 2004 ; Goodhue and Wagner, 2018 ; Espinal and Tubau, 2019 ) . Japanese descriptions distinguish neutral negative questions from questions with a positive expectation ( Kuno, 1973 ; Kameyama, 2013 ) . Korean studies distinguish short and long negation and show contextual effects on the acceptability of particle–sentence combinations ( Wee, 2019 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) ; the Korean templates here cover long negation. These distinctions motivate retaining the wording and response direction in the analysis of the negative interrogative.
blocks.zh: 该清单区分了构造,因为反应解释取决于否定的放置和上下文以及语言(Romero和Han,2004年;Goodhue和Wagner,2018年;Espinal和Tubau,2019年)。 日本的描述将中性负面问题与有积极期望的问题区分开来(Kuno,1973年;Kameyama,2013年). 韩国的研究区分了短和长的否定,并显示了对粒子-判罚组合的可接受性的背景影响(Wee, 2019;Kim等人, 2024);这里的韩国模板涵盖了长的否定. 这些区别促使人们在分析负面审讯时保留措辞和反应方向。

blocks.en: Mandarin descriptions discuss the \cjkfont 是否/ \cjkfont 是不是 ( shìfǒu / shì-bu-shì ) question frames ( Lü, 1985 ) and how \cjkfont 是/ \cjkfont 不 ( shì / bù ) track the answerer’s opinion against the polarity of the question’s main point ( Lu, 2002 ) , while elicited rejecting responses can combine particles, sentence content, prosody, and gesture ( Li et al., 2016 ) . French oui / non / si interpretation is sensitive to the scope of negation ( Pasquereau, 2020 ) . Human survey studies also distinguish the meaning of an attitude from how respondents map it to yes/no options under contrasting evaluative wording ( Holleman, 2006 ; Kamoen et al., 2017 ) . This motivates balancing which of the concept pair’s terms a question names as a separate design factor.
blocks.zh: 普通话的描述讨论了\cjkfont 是否/\cjkfont 是不是(shìfǒu / shì-bu-shì)的问题框架(Lü,1985年)和\cjkfont $102./\cjkfont 不(shì/bù)如何跟踪回答者对问题要点的极性的看法(Lu,2002年),同时引起拒绝的答复可以结合粒子,句子内容,亲和手势(Li等人,2016年). 法语oui/非/si解释对否定的范围很敏感(Pasquereau,2020年). 人类调查研究还区分了一种态度的含义,以及答卷人如何在对比评价措辞下将其映射为是/否(Holleman,2006年;Kamoen等人,2017年)。 这促使在概念对称的术语中,将问题名称作为一个单独的设计因素加以平衡。

blocks.en: The free condition asks for one sentence. The verdict-first instruction is “Start your sentence with a verdict word.” The yes/no-first instruction is “Start with yes or no.”, with the reverse particle order tested where available. Proposition-label prompts ask “Answer with one letter.” and attach each letter to a complete proposition, such as “Z: I oppose what Elsa did. W: I support what Elsa did.” The design records the actual letters and their proposition map for each item.
blocks.zh: 自由条件要求一个句子. 第一判决指令是“用判决词开始判决”。 " 是 " / " 不 " 第一种指令是 " 是 " 或 " 开始 " ,在有相反粒子顺序的情况下进行测试。 Proposition-label points问“Answer with one letter ” ,并将每封信附在一个完整的命题上,例如“Z:我反对Elsa所做的一切。 W:我支持Elsa所做的一切。” 设计记录每个项目的实际字母及其命题地图.

blocks.en: German particle choices include ja , nein , and doch ; French choices include oui , non , and si . Their order varies across items as recorded in the design. Additional battery conditions ask for a listed evaluative term, an English yes or no opening in a Chinese, German, or Japanese prompt, or a Chinese \cjkfont 对/ \cjkfont 不对 ( duì / bù duì , “correct/not correct”) opening. These conditions contribute to the battery’s total reply count; the profile analyses use the answer constraints specified in the main text.
blocks.zh: 德国的粒子选择包括 ja, nein, 和 doch; 法国的选择包括oui, 非和si. 其顺序因设计中记录的项目而异. 附加电池条件要求列出一个评价术语,在中文、德文或日文提示中以英文表示是或否打开,或以中文表示\cjkfont oi/\cjkfont 112(duì/bù duì,“正确/不正确”)打开。 这些条件有助于电池的总答数;剖面分析采用了正文中规定的答数限制。

blocks.en: We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5 (Haiku), Claude Sonnet 5 (Sonnet), Claude Opus 5 (Opus), GPT-6 luna (luna), GPT-6.1 sol (sol), Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (Gemini), Qwen3.8-27B (Qwen), and Mistral Medium 3.5 (Mistral). The design assigns the same prompt inventory to every model, with independent generations of the prompts selected for repetition. Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus use the non-thinking setting; luna uses no reasoning and sol uses low reasoning effort. Gemini and Mistral use their default generation settings, and Qwen runs with thinking disabled. These settings form part of the measured model, and Appendix A9 reports their observed sampling variability.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Claude Haiku 4.5(海库)、Claude Sonnet 5(索内特)、Claude Opus 5(奥普斯)、GPT-6 luna(卢纳)、GPT-6.1 sol(索尔)、双子座3.1 Flash-Lite(格米尼)、Qune3.8-27B(Quen)和Mistral Medium3.5(米斯特拉尔)。 设计为每个模型分配相同的即时盘点,选择独立世代的提示重复. Haiku,Sonnet,和Opus使用非思考设置;Luna使用无推理,Sol使用低推理努力. 双子座和Mistral使用其默认的生成设置,Quen运行时思维被禁用. 这些设置构成测量模型的一部分,附录A9报告了所观测到的取样可变性。

blocks.en: The judge sees the story, instruction, question, pair-specific reference proposition, and verbatim reply. Its task is to code what the reply asserts about that proposition while ignoring the opening token and its own evaluation of the story. The judge’s categories distinguish sentences that assert the reference proposition, assert its opposite, take both sides or conditions, or take no position. The last category includes refusals and comments about the question that do not express a judgment. Only sentences asserting the reference proposition or its opposite receive a decisive reading. The fixed decoder separately reads the opening expression from the reply text and the prompt’s recorded mapping.
blocks.zh: 法官看到故事、指示、提问、对称的参考命题和逐字记录。 它的任务是在无视开场白和它自己对故事的评价的同时,对答复对此主张的内容进行编码。 法官的类别区分那些主张参考命题、主张相反、采取双方或条件或不采取立场的句子。 最后一类包括拒绝和评论不表示判断的问题。 只有主张参考命题的句子或相反的句子才得到决定性的解读. 固定的解码器会从回复文本中单独读取开口表达式和prote的录制映射.

blocks.en: The primary sentence labels use Claude Sonnet 5 with low adaptive reasoning and a uniform codebook. The cross-model audit compares those labels with GPT-6 astra at high reasoning effort and obtains agreement of 95.5 % 95.5\% on 4,590 replies. A separate comparison with Claude Fable 5 at high reasoning effort gives 97.2 % 97.2\% on 4,530 replies (60 of the sampled replies were refused by that judge’s safety classifier and carry no label). The audited replies cover 153 strata of model, constraint group, and language, with 720–840 replies per language; 1,225 are negative-interrogative replies, among them 152 yes/no-first replies and 47 on which the fixed rule and the judged sentence disagree. Table 7 gives agreement and opposite-decisive counts per stratum, the intervals, and the counts on which the primary judge gave a decisive reading; the two audit judges reverse a decisive stance on 10 and 9 replies in all, and their other disagreements involve at least one undecided category. Native readers (the authors for Chinese, English, and German; a collaborator for Japanese) labelled 100 replies per language drawn from the same sample, stratified over judged part and constraint group, with the same categories and without model names or machine labels. They agree with the primary labels on 95.5% of the 400 replies ( κ = 0.89 \kappa=0.89 ; 96, 93, 96, and 97 of 100 in Chinese, English, German, and Japanese), with the astra labels on 93.0%, and with the Fable labels on 95.4% of 389 replies. On the 363 replies where reader and primary judge are both decisive, no label opposes the other, and each of the 18 differences is a reply the judge codes as taking both sides or conditions, typically a reply that takes a side and adds a reservation, which the readers code on that side.
blocks.zh: 主句标签使用Claude Sonnet 5,适应性低的推理和统一的代码本. 跨模式审计将这些标签与GPT-6 astra进行高度推理比较,并就4 590份答复达成了95.5%的一致意见。 与Claude Fable 5进行单独比较后, 已审计的答复包括153种模式、约束组和语言,每种语言有720-840份答复;1 225份是否定式的讯问答复,其中有152份是/不是第一次答复,47份是/不是,固定规则和判断的句子不同意。 表7按层次、间隔和主要法官作出决定性解读的计数给出了一致和相反决定的计数;两位审计法官在10和9份答复上完全颠倒了决定性立场,他们的其他分歧至少涉及一个未决定的类别。 土著读者(中文、英文和德文作者;日文合作者)对从同一样本中抽取的每个语言的100份答复进行了分类,对部分和限制类进行了分级,分类相同,没有模型名称或机器标签。 他们同意对400份答复中的95.5%(0.89\kappa=0.89;中文、英文、德文和日文的96、93、96和100份中的97份)的主要标签,对93.0%的Astra标签,以及389份答复中的95.4%的Fable标签。 在363个回答中,读者和主裁判都具有决定性,没有标签反对对方,18个区别中每个区别都是法官代码作为采取双方或条件的回答,典型的回答是采取一边并增加保留,读者在那边的代码.

blocks.en: Two test–retest sets repeat the same sentence judge on 300 identical negative-interrogative yes/no-first prompts each, 50 per language. Agreement is 96.3% and 97.7% ( κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 and 0.95), with most differences involving undecided categories and one and 3 flips between opposite decisive judgments. These checks complement the cross-model audits by measuring repeatability under unchanged judging instructions.
blocks.zh: 两套测试-重试在300个相同的反诘问式是/不是第一个提示上重复同一个句子法官,每句50个. 协议为96.3%和97.7%(UF=0.92\kappa=0.92和0.95),大多数差异涉及未确定的类别,相互相反的决定性判断有1和3翻. 这些检查是对跨模式审计的补充,根据不变的判断指示衡量重复性。

blocks.en: A core-strata audit then re-judges, with Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 at high reasoning effort, a seeded sample of 3,263 replies on which the fixed rule and the primary label are both decisive, drawn per model–language cell and split by whether the two readings agree or conflict (Table 7 ). Where the readings agree, the audit judges agree with the primary label on 96–99% of the replies. On the negative-interrogative yes/no-first replies where they conflict, the audit judges uphold the sentence reading against the token rule for 93.5% (Fable 5), 92.8% (Opus 5.5), and 96.4% (Sonnet 5 high) of the replies, all three together for 809 of 880 replies with three labels and none of them for 23; on the verdict-first conflicts under the extended rule they uphold it for 91.0%, 90.7%, and 90.9%. On the rarer plain-question conflicts they uphold it for only 48.7%, 49.0%, and 48.1%, while agreeing with one another on 96.7–97.9% of all core replies: about half of the plain-question disagreement in Figure 2 b reflects the primary judge rather than the token, whereas the negative-interrogative disagreement does not. Fable 5 refused 3 of its 222 calls (45 replies) and Sonnet 5 at high effort exhausted its token budget on 14 calls (206 replies); those replies carry no label from that judge.
blocks.zh: 然后,由Claude Fable 5、Claude Opus 5.5和Claude Sonnet 5进行核心层审计,在高推理努力下,对3,263份答复进行了初步抽样,其中固定规则和主要标签既具有决定性,又按模式-语言单元格抽取,并按两种读数是否一致或冲突加以分割(表7)。 如果阅读同意,审计法官同意96-99%的答复的主要标签。 审计法官在否定性讯问是/不是第一次答复时,坚持对93.5%的答复(第5页)、92.8%的答复(第5.5页)和96.4%的答复(第5页高)的判决,所有三个答复加在一起,880份答复中有809份有3个标签,23份没有标签;关于延长规则下的判决第一冲突,他们坚持91.0%、90.7%和90.9%。 在较罕见的简单问题冲突上,他们只坚持48.7%、49.0%和48.1%,同时就所有核心答复的96.7-97.9%达成一致:图2b中的简单问题分歧中约有一半反映了主要法官,而不是象征性的,而负面的讯问分歧则并非如此。 第5话拒绝其222个电话中的3个(45个答复),Sonnet 5在14个电话(206个答复)上花费了象征性的预算;这些答复没有该法官的标签。

blocks.en: Appendix A2 Coverage and selection
blocks.zh: 附录A2 覆盖范围和选择

blocks.en: Figure A2 separates decisive coverage, story support, and the selection of replies for the negative-interrogative mapping analysis. Decisive coverage uses the judged sentence for free and verdict-first answers, and the fixed decoder for yes/no-first and proposition-label answers. A reply contributes to a judgment profile only when the selected reading asserts the reference proposition or its opposite. Sentences taking both sides or conditions, sentences taking no position, and unreadable openings provide no decisive value for their respective readings. The alternative-question yes/no-first condition is excluded from these coverage summaries because a bare particle does not select between the alternatives.
blocks.zh: 图A2分别了决定性的覆盖,故事支持,以及负面询问绘图分析的答案选择. 决定性的覆盖使用判断的句子来进行自由的和判决的第一答案,固定的解码器来进行"是/否第一"和命题标签答案. 只有在选定阅读者坚持参考命题或相反时,答复才有助于判断概况。 采取两边或条件的句子,句子没有位置,且无法读取的开口,对各自的读数没有决定性的价值. 这些覆盖摘要中不包括替代问题是/不是第一条件,因为光粒子不选择替代品。

blocks.en: The selection chain counts every generated reply of the negative-interrogative yes/no-first condition, including repeated generations. It contains 77,952 generated replies, all with a judged sentence. A reply enters the mapping analysis when its sentence is decisive and its opening is a recognised yes/no or reversal particle. Restricting this usable pool to the first generation of each prompt gives the wording cells in Figure 5 ; this selection contains 56,665 replies.
blocks.zh: 选择链将每个生成的回答都算在负面询问是/不是第一条件上,包括重复的几代人. 它载有77 952份答复,所有答复都有判决。 答案输入绘图分析时,其句子是决定性的,开口是公认的是/否或反向粒子。 将这个可用的集合限制在每条提示的第一代, 给出图5中的措辞单元格; 此选择包含56,665个答复 。

blocks.en: The same-reply decoder diagnostic and the particle-mapping analysis have different inclusion rules. The former accepts any opening that the fixed decoder maps to a decisive reading in the yes/no-first condition. The latter additionally requires an opening particle so that the polarity share is defined. Figure A2 makes this particle-specific selection visible, while Table 7 reports the reply counts for the decoder comparison.
blocks.zh: 同型的解码诊断和粒子映射分析有不同的包含规则. 前者接受任何开口,即固定解码器地图在"是/不是第一条件"中进行决定性的读取. 后者还需要一个开口粒子才能定义极性份额. 图A2使这个粒子特异性选择可见,而表7则报告解码器比较的答案计数.

blocks.en: Figure A2: Coverage and selection. The chain counts all generations; the wording cells use the first generation of each prompt.

blocks.en: Figure A3 expands the form comparisons into individual model × \times language cells. Each marker compares story scores on the stories common to the two readouts; the bar summarises models within a language. Residual-profile correlations use the stories shared by all models in that language so that the story consensus has common support. The red row retains its own axis limits because the preset reading of the negative-interrogative token produces a wider spread. Table 3 provides the cell counts, medians, ranges, and signed shifts for the comparisons summarised in the main text.

blocks.en: The worked example follows Opus in Chinese from story scores to their agreement statistics. Free sentences and proposition labels have a story-level correlation of 0.93 0.93 on their common stories. Their mean absolute story difference is 0.11 0.11 , so close ordering coexists with changes in individual scores. Removing the story consensus and model means leaves a residual-profile correlation of 0.67 0.67 . The scatterplot displays many coincident endpoint scores with transparency, which prevents repeated points from appearing to be separate observations.

blocks.en: Figure A5 conditions the polarity share on what the judged sentence asserts. A rejecting sentence affirms the term questioned under negation, whereas a confirming sentence denies that term. The upper and lower matrices preserve the same wording rows and model columns, allowing a fixed opening particle to be distinguished from a mapping that follows the sentence. A model that always begins with “no” occupies opposite ends of the polarity scale across these directions.
blocks.zh: 图A5对判断的句子所主张的极性份额提出了条件。 驳回判决确认被质疑的用语为否定,而确认判决否认该用语。 上下矩阵保留了相同的措辞行和模型列,使得固定的开口粒子与句子之后的映射区分开来. 一个总是从“不”开始的模式占据了横跨这些方向的极性尺度的两端。

blocks.en: Every displayed direction cell contains at least 15 usable replies, and every wording mean includes all eight models. The lower panels connect these aggregate patterns to actual sentences. blocks.en: The literature markers distinguish descriptive accounts from experiments and distinguish rejecting answers from confirming answers when a source tests only one direction. The English anchors combine descriptions with experimental responses, elicited ( Goodhue and Wagner, 2018 ) or selected from a given yes/no pair ( Park, 2023 ) , and theoretical accounts ( Kramer and Rawlins, 2011 ; Kameyama, 2013 ) ; the Mandarin anchors combine descriptive accounts with elicited production ( Lu, 2002 ; Holmberg, 2016 ; Zhang and Vanek, 2021 ) . Japanese and French markers draw on descriptions and elicited responses ( Kuno, 1973 ; Kameyama, 2013 ) , and the Korean marker uses forced-choice answer selection ( Park, 2023 ) . German anchors include a grammatical description ( Dudenredaktion, 2009 ) and acceptability judgments about negative assertions ( Meijer et al., 2015 ; Claus et al., 2017 ) . Hollow experimental markers identify these assertion studies, which concern a related discourse context rather than the plotted question construction.
blocks.zh: 文献标记将描述性叙述与实验区分开来,并将拒绝答案和确认答案区分开来,当一个源只测试一个方向时. 英国主播将描述与实验反应相结合,引出(Goodhue和Wagner,2018年)或从给定的"是/否对"(Park,2023年)中选取,以及理论叙述(Kramer和Rawlins,2011年;Kameyama,2013年);普通话主播将描述性叙述与引出生产(Lu,2002年;Holmberg,2016年;张和Vanek,2021年). 日本和法国的标语参考了描述并引来了回应(Kuno,1973;Kameyama,2013),韩国标语使用强制选择答案选择(Park,2023). 德国主播包括语法描述(Dudenredaktion,2009年)和对负面断言的可接受判断(Meijer等人,2015年;Claus等人,2017年). 洞穴实验标记确定了这些论断研究,这些论断研究涉及的是相关的讨论背景,而不是所规划的问题构造.

blocks.en: Keeping the particle form separate from contextual confirmation also follows the distinct coding categories of Stivers and Enfield (2010) ; Enfield et al. (2019) analyse form choice within confirming answers. Mandarin conversation studies likewise distinguish single-word and repetition-based answers and show that the negative expression \cjkfont 没有 ( méiyǒu ) can do different interactional work depending on the preceding question ( Xie, 2018 ; Wang, 2020 ; Wang, 2008 ) . The dialogue exchanges differ from the vignette prompts in topic, register, and conversational context, and provide background rather than a matched validation of the model cells.
blocks.zh: 将粒子形式与上下文确认区分开来也遵循Stivers和Enfield(2010年);Enfield等人(2019年)在确认答案中分析形式选择。 普通话对话研究同样区分了单词和基于重复的答案,并显示负面表达式\cjkfont et/ et/(méiyǒu)可以根据前一个问题(谢,2018;王,2020;王,2008)做不同的交互工作. 对话交流与话题、登记和对话背景的vignette提示不同,提供背景而不是模型单元格的匹配验证。

blocks.en: Figure A7: Dialogue-corpus and literature background by construction. Particle-initial answers from transcribed conversation, subtitles, scenario-based meetings, crowdsourced dialogue, and institutional exchanges use the same surface forms and receive judge labels, with small samples. Literature anchors distinguish constructions; hollow experimental markers show evidence from negative assertions. The display supplies background for Figure 5 rather than a matched human validation of the model cells.
blocks.zh: 图A7:按建筑分列的对话公司和文献背景。 从转录的谈话,字幕,情景会议,多方联动的对话,以及机构交流中获得的粒子-初始答案使用相同的表面形式并接收法官的标签,样本小. 文学锚能区分构造;空心实验标记能显示证据和负面断言. 该显示提供了图5的背景,而不是模型细胞的匹配的人类验证.

blocks.en: Appendix A8 Concept pairs and wording sensitivity
blocks.zh: 附录A8 概念配对和措辞敏感性

blocks.en: Figure A8 lists the questions naming either term of every language-specific concept pair. The pair identifies the evaluative contrast, and each question names one of its terms. The sensitivity analysis changes one of pair, language, or model while comparing single-pair story vectors on their common stories. It therefore asks how much a wording choice changes the measurement before the story estimator averages over pairs.
blocks.zh: 图A8列出了每个语言特定概念对的任意一个术语的命名问题. 双人确定评价对比,每个问题都列出其术语之一。 灵敏度分析会改变对称,语言,或模型的一种,同时比较他们共同故事上的单pair故事矢量. 因此,它询问在故事估计器平均成对之前,措辞选择会改变多少。

blocks.en: For proposition labels, changing the concept pair within a model and language gives a median story-level correlation of 0.82 0.82 . Changing the model within a language and pair gives 0.72 0.72 . The corresponding free-sentence correlations are higher, but their residual-profile correlations reveal less shared variation after the story consensus is removed. Averaging concept pairs consequently has a distinct measurement purpose alongside balancing which term of each pair the question names.
blocks.zh: 对于命题标签,改变一个模型和语言中的概念配对,使故事层次的中位关系为0.820.82. 在语言和对称中改变模型给出0.72 0.72 。 相应的自由判决的关联性较高,但其残留的关联性在故事共识被移除后揭示出较少的共享差异. 因此,在平衡每对问题名称的哪一个术语的同时,动画概念配对具有独特的测量目的。

blocks.en: The leave-one-pair-out analysis repeats the same-model cross-language residual comparison after excluding each concept-pair name in turn. The inventory contains 23 language-specific entries but 22 exclusions because the English and French pairs named incorrect are removed together. The figure displays every exclusion beside the all-pairs reference so the effect of each exclusion remains visible.
blocks.zh: 留守一派分析在依次排除每个概念派名称后,重复了同一模式的跨语言剩余比较. 该清单包含23个特定语言条目,但有22个排除,因为英文和法文对称不正确被一并删除。 数字显示除所有参考物之外的所有排除物,因此每个排除物的效果仍然可见。

blocks.en: Figure A8: Concept pairs. Questions naming either term of the 23 language-specific pairs; wording sensitivity when changing pair, language, or model on single-pair story vectors; and leave-one-pair-out stability of the same-model cross-language residual correlation. Orders are equally weighted. The leave-one-pair-out analysis has 22 units because the English and French pairs named incorrect are removed together.
blocks.zh: 图A8:概念对。 问题命名23种语言特异性对称中的任意一种名词;在单派故事矢量上改变对称,语言,或模型时的措辞敏感性;以及同型跨语言残存关联的一派离断稳定性. 订单同样加权。 离休一派分析共有22个单元,因为命名不正确的英法对子被一起删除.

blocks.en: Appendix A9 Repetition and aggregation stability
blocks.zh: 附录A9 重复和汇总稳定性

blocks.en: Figure A9 separates variation across repeated generations from variation introduced when scores average across option orders, terms named in the question, and concept pairs. A repeated prompt fixes the model, language, story, concept pair, question form, named term, answer instruction, and option order. The repetition panel uses prompts with three decisive generations and records whether those readings split. For free sentences, the split share rises from 2.5 % 2.5\% under plain questions to 4.0 % 4.0\% under negative interrogatives. The pattern differs across models and answer constraints, as the markers in the figure make visible.
blocks.zh: 图A9将不同世代的差别与不同选择顺序、问题中命名的术语和概念对等的分数平均时引入的差别区分开来。 重复的即时修正模型,语言,故事,概念对,问题形式,命名术语,答案指令,和选项顺序. 重复面板使用带有三个决定性世代的提示,并记录这些读数是否分裂. 对于自由的句子,拆分份额从普通问题下的2.5% 2.5 QQ上升到负面审讯下的4.0% 4. 由于图中标记的显示,不同模型的图案和答案的制约不同.

blocks.en: The association between unstable repetitions and disagreement across readouts is exploratory because both quantities use overlapping sampled replies. Across eligible model × \times language × \times story observations, the Spearman correlation is 0.25 0.25 . This association locates stories on which repeated sampling contributes to readout variability without assigning that variability to a particular cause.
blocks.zh: 不稳定的重复与不同读出之间的分歧之间的联系是探索性的,因为两个数量都使用了重复的抽样答复。 在符合条件的模型 \ times 语言 \ times 故事观察中, Spearman 的关联是 0.25 0.25 。 这种关联查找反复抽样有助于读出可变性的故事,而不将这种可变性分配给某一特定原因。

blocks.en: The aggregation audit follows the successive sources of intermediate scores. A difference across repeated generations or label orders is an observed change in the decisive reading. For changes of the named term or concept pair, the audit records differences of at least 0.5 0.5 after the lower-level averages. Label choices differ more often when the named term changes than free-sentence judgments, 27 % 27\% versus 8 % 8\% . Order changes contribute further intermediate label scores. The panel reports the denominator at each aggregation level so these shares can be read as different comparisons.
blocks.zh: 汇总审计遵循中间分数的连续来源。 反复代代的区别或标签命令是观察到的决定性解读的变化. 对于命名名词或概念配对的更改,审计记录的差异在较低水平平均值之后至少为0.5.0.5. 与自由判决相比, 更改顺序会进一步贡献中间标签分数. 小组在每个汇总级别上报告分母,这样这些股份就可以被读作不同的比较.

blocks.en: Restricting label aggregation reduces, but leaves, the endpoint difference. Free-sentence scores are at an endpoint in 81 % 81\% of model × \times language × \times story observations, against 57 % 57\% for labels restricted to one order and one generation. The judged examples include hedged answers classified as taking both sides or conditions, while counting undecided sentences as the midpoint does not improve agreement with labels. The audit therefore retains the decisive-only estimator used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 限制标签聚合会减少,但叶子,端点差异. Free-Presentence的分数在81%的81%的模型 ×\times 语言 ×\times 故事观察中处于终点,而57%的标语限制在一阶一代. 被判断的例子包括被套期解答被归类为采取双方或条件,同时将未决定的句子计为中点并不能改善与标签的一致. 因此,审计保留了整个文件中所使用的唯一决定性的估算数字。

blocks.en: Figure A9: Repetition and aggregation stability. (a) Share of identical prompts whose three decisive generations disagree, by answer constraint, question form, language, model, and story group. (b) Stories with unstable generations also disagree more between readouts; the relationship is exploratory and uses shared sampling. (c) Sources of intermediate story scores under plain questions: repeated generations, option orders, named terms, and concept pairs, followed by the share of story scores at either endpoint.
blocks.zh: 图 A9:重复与聚合稳定性. (a) 三代决定性人通过回答限制、问题形式、语言、模式和故事组而不同意的相同提示。 (b) 几代人不稳定的故事在宣读之间也有较大分歧;这种关系是探索性的,采用共同抽样。 (c) 普通问题下的中间故事分数来源:重复代数、选择顺序、命名术语和概念对数,然后是故事分数在任一端点的比例。

blocks.en: Appendix A10 Mean-level views and consistency across readouts
blocks.zh: 附录A10 平均水平观点和阅读结果的一致性

blocks.en: Figure A10 complements the pairwise profile comparison with cell means and replication across readouts. The heat maps average each cell’s available stories and print that support beneath the mean. The variance decomposition instead fixes a common story set across models and the four languages with the broader coverage. Table 6 records the pairwise class estimates and the fixed-support sensitivity check, preserving their different units of aggregation.
blocks.zh: 图A10补充了与单元格手段的对等配置对比,并跨读数复制。 热图平均显示每个单元格可用的故事, 差异的分解则修正了一个跨模型和四种语言的共用故事集,涵盖面更广。 表6记录了双向类估计和固定支持敏感性检查,保留了它们不同的汇总单位.

blocks.en: For English, Chinese, German, and Japanese, model differences account for 0.84 0.84 of the proposition-label mean matrix’s variance. The corresponding share for free sentences is 0.81 0.81 . Language main effects are small in these common-story matrices, while the interaction retains differences specific to a model and language. These mean-level summaries complement the story-profile comparison because averaging over stories removes the item structure that identifies a model.
blocks.zh: 对于英文、中文、德文和日文,模型差异占命题-标签平均值矩阵差异的0.84 0.84。 免费判决的相应份额为0.81 0.81。 语言的主要效果在这些共同的故事矩阵中很小,而相互作用则保留了一种模型和语言特有的差异. 这些中层摘要补充了故事的描述比较,因为平均比故事要多,取消了识别模型的项目结构.

blocks.en: The replication panels use one observation for each model and language pair. The cross-language story-level correlations under labels and free sentences correlate at 0.59 0.59 ; the residual-profile correlations correlate at 0.33 0.33 . The signed mean language shifts reproduce less closely across these readouts. The final panel splits each cell’s concept pairs into two subsets (two and two, or one and two for Japanese, which has three pairs) and reports the correlation between the two subsets’ story profiles, uncorrected, as a reference for how much profile structure repeats within each readout.
blocks.zh: 复制面板对每个模型和语言配对使用一个观察. 标签和自由句下的跨语言故事层面的关联性为0.59 0.59;剩余视角的关联性为0.33 0.33。 签名的普通语言转换在读数中复制得较少。 最终的面板将每个单元格的概念对子拆分为两个子集(两个和两个,或一个和两个为日语,它有三个对子),并报告两个子集的故事剖面的关联性,没有校正,作为每个读出中重复多少描述结构的参考.

blocks.en: Table 6 adds two readings of the same cell structure. The nearest-neighbor block treats each cell as an unlabeled profile: under residual r r , 39 of the 48 proposition-label cells have another language of the same model as their closest other cell, against 5 expected by chance, and the five same-model cells rank on average 5.7th among a cell’s 47 neighbors. Under free sentences the count falls to 15 of 48. The story-group block recomputes the class means on acceptable, contested, and violation stories separately, over pairs with at least eight common stories of that group. The same-model advantage in story-level correlation is largest on acceptable stories ( 0.79 0.79 against 0.69 0.69 ), present on contested stories ( 0.70 0.70 against 0.62 0.62 ), and absent on violations ( 0.43 0.43 against 0.46 0.46 ), where every cell condemns the act; the mean absolute story difference and the residual correlation keep the same-model advantage in every group. The overall story-level correlations of 0.88 0.88 and 0.81 0.81 are therefore raised by the structure that every cell shares across groups, while the model signature lives in the stories on which models disagree.
blocks.zh: 表6增加了两个相同单元格结构的读数。 近邻区块将每个细胞视为一个无标签的剖面:在剩余r r 下,48个命题-标签细胞中的39个具有与它们最近的其它细胞相同的模式语言,而5个是偶然预期的,5个同型的细胞平均排在细胞的47个邻居的第5.7位. 根据免费判决,计数为48人中的15人。 故事组的块重新计算 课程意味着可以接受,有争议的, 和违规的故事分开, 超过对夫妇, 故事层面关联性中相同的模型优势在可接受的故事上最大(0.79 0.79对0.69 0.69),在有争议的故事上呈现(0.70 0.70对0.62 0.62),在侵权上缺失(0.43 0.43对0.46 0.46),每个细胞都谴责此行为;平均绝对故事差异和剩余关联性在每一个群体中保持相同的模型优势. 因此,0.88 0.88 和0.81 0.81 0.81的总的故事层次相关性是由每个细胞在群体间共享的结构提出的,而模型特征则生活在模型有分歧的故事中.

blocks.en: Figure A10: Mean-level views. Cell-mean heat maps with story counts; common-story variance shares for the four languages with broader coverage; signed mean language shifts under labels and free sentences; and replication of each model’s language-pair correlations across those readouts. The final panel gives concept-pair split-half correlations, uncorrected, as a reference for repeated measurement within a readout.
blocks.zh: 图A10:平均值。 带故事计数的细胞-分子热图;覆盖范围更广的四种语言的常见-故事差异份额;在标签和免费句子下签名的平均语言转换;以及复制每个模型在读数中的语言-pair关系。 最终的面板给出了概念-pair 分裂半相关,未校正,作为读出内重复测量的参考.

blocks.en: Table 6: Cell-pair classes for plain questions. The first block gives class means and 95% story-bootstrap intervals on pairwise-common stories; differences subtract the same-language class from the same-model class and use a joint bootstrap. The second block fixes the story set across every included cell; the free-sentence readout has only seven stories common to all languages, so that estimate is omitted. The third block treats each cell as an unlabeled profile and asks which other cell it resembles most, and where its five same-model cells rank among its 47 neighbors. The fourth block recomputes the class means on the stories of one group, over pairs with at least eight common stories of that group. Models and languages are fixed. Within-language residual centring constrains the same-language residual class.
blocks.zh: 表6:简单问题的细胞铺班。 第一个区块给出了类手段,95%的故事-短片间隔在对称的常见故事上;差异将同语言类从同型类中减去,使用联合靴子. 第二块将故事设定在每一个包含的单元格中;自由判决读出只有7个所有语言共有的故事,因此该估计被省略. 第三块将每个细胞视为一个无标签的剖面,并询问它最相似的其他哪个细胞,以及它的5个同型细胞在它的47个邻居中排位. 第四块重新计算班级意味着一个组的故事, 超过对组至少八个常见的故事. 模式和语言是固定的。 语言内残基限制同语言残基类.

blocks.en: Appendix A11 Parsing audit
blocks.zh: 附录A11 审阅审计

blocks.en: Figure A11 distinguishes an unreadable opening from a disagreement between a readable opening and the judged sentence. Readability is measured over generated replies. Disagreement is measured over replies for which both readings are decisive, with equal weight assigned to model × \times language cells in the figure’s summary. Table 7 retains the reply denominators alongside the judging audits.
blocks.zh: 图A11区分了不可读开口与可读开口与判断句之间的分歧. 可读性通过生成的答复来衡量。 对两种读数都具有决定性的回答, 表7在进行判断性审计的同时保留了答复分母。

blocks.en: The extension to the fixed verdict-word rule consists of four stated operations. It recognises inflected and polite forms of listed words, reads preposed negation immediately before a listed term, recognises derived adverbs, and reverses a previously readable term when the following negation changes its polarity. For example, \cjkfont 反対しません ( hantai shimasen , “I do not oppose”) is read as a negated verdict instead of the unnegated \cjkfont 反対 ( hantai , “oppose”). Evaluative words outside the listed vocabulary and replies that begin with a full sentence remain for the sentence judge.
blocks.zh: 固定判决词规则的延伸包括四项所述行动。 它承认所列词语的反映和礼貌形式,在所列词语之前就读作预先否定,承认衍生副词,并在下列否定改变其极性时倒置以前可读的词语。 例如,\cjkfont QQ(hantai shimasen,“我不反对”)被理解为否定的判决,而不是未否定的\cjkfont QQ(hantai,“反对”)。 所列词汇外的评价词和从满句开始的答复,仍保留给判刑法官.

blocks.en: The extension raises overall verdict-opener readability from 0.66 0.66 to 0.68 0.68 . It also changes readings that the original prefix rule had assigned to unnegated terms. Among Japanese plain-question verdict replies, the resulting readout disagreement decreases from 12.5 % 12.5\% to 1.2 % 1.2\% . The before-and-after values in Figure A11 distinguish these changes in reading from the additional replies that become readable.
blocks.zh: 延长后,可读判决书的总可读性从0.66 0.66提高到0.68 0.68。 它也改变了原前缀规则分配给未否定名词的读数. 在日本的简单问题裁决答复中,结果的宣读分歧从12.5 % 12.5 %下降到1.2 % 1.2 % 。 图A11中的前后值将阅读中的这些变化与可读的其他答复区分开来.

blocks.en: The reason categories describe the openings left unreadable by the rule. Figure A11 b starts from the original unreadable pool and identifies the portion recovered by the extension. Its bracketed legend reports the composition of the remaining unreadable pool under the extended rule. The bar segments use the original unreadable pool as their denominator, whereas the legend describes what remains unreadable after the extension.
blocks.zh: 原因分类描述规则留下的无法读取的开口. 图A11b从原来的不可读池开始,并识别扩展回收的部分. 其括号内的传说报道了扩展规则下剩余不可读池的构成. 条片段使用原始的不可读池作为其分母,而传说则描述了扩展后仍然不可读的东西.

blocks.en: Figure A11: Parsing audit: the fixed decoder against the sentence judge. (a) Opener readability by answer constraint, question form, language, and model under the fixed verdict-word rule and its extension. (b) Causes of unreadable verdict openings, with the portion recovered by the extension shown separately. (c) Readout disagreement on replies where both readings are decisive, by question form and language or model: the verdict word under the extended rule, with grey ticks for the original rule where it differs, the token and the letter under the fixed rule. The summary columns give the mean over model × \times language cells, the pooled share, and n n . Of the 71,282 negative-interrogative token replies, 21 opened with a verdict word rather than a particle (20 Chinese, 1 Japanese). Replies behind the series of Figure 2 b: yes/no token 71,481 / 2,565 / 71,282 (F1 / F3 / F4; the token after an alternative question has 17 such replies and is not plotted); verdict word 21,193 / 20,530 / 20,780 / 18,737 (F1–F4); letter 3,169 / 2,825 / 2,685 / 3,235.
blocks.zh: 图A11:解析审计:固定解码器对判官. (a) 固定判决词规则及其延伸下的可读性,包括回答限制、提问形式、语言和模式。 (b) 无法读取判决开口的原因,通过延期收回的部分单独列出。 (c) 按问题形式和语言或模式,在两种读数都具有决定性的回答上宣读不同意见:扩展规则下的判决词,在不同的原规则、符号和固定规则下的信句上加上灰色的勾。 汇总列给出的平均值大于 \\ times 语言单元格、 集合共享和 n 。 在71,282个负面审讯符号回复中,21个以判决词而不是粒子(20个中文,1个日文)打开. 图2b系列背后的答复:是/否 71 481 / 2 565 / 71 282(F1 / F3 / F4;另类问题后的答复有17份,没有绘制);判决字21 193 / 20 530 / 20 780 / 18 737(F1-F4); 3 169 / 3 825 / 2 685 / 3 235。

blocks.en: Table 7: Judge audits and opener coverage. Audit intervals are 95% intervals; each test–retest set repeats the judge on 300 negative-interrogative yes/no-first replies, 50 per language, with one and three flips between the reference proposition and its opposite. The native readers’ labels agree with the astra labels on 93.0% and with the Fable labels on 95.4% of the same replies, and no decisive reader label opposes a decisive machine label. The stratum block gives agreement with the primary judge and the number of replies on which the two judges assert opposite decisive propositions (“Opposite”); the audited negative-interrogative yes/no-first replies number 19–33 per language. The core-strata block re-judges, with three Claude judge configurations at high reasoning effort, a seeded sample of replies on which the fixed rule and the primary sentence label are both decisive, drawn per model × \times language cell and split by whether the two readings agree or conflict; agreement is with the primary label, so on conflict rows it is the share of replies on which the audit judge upholds the sentence reading against the fixed rule. Over all audited replies, the remaining disagreements move a reply between a decisive and an undecided category (134 and 42 for astra; 47 and 54 for Fable) or between the two undecided categories (19; 15). Coverage includes the three constraints shown, excluding a 13 824-reply control stratum. Readability divides readable openers by generated replies. The extension changes the verdict-word rule; alternative-question particles are unreadable by design. Both decisive requires a decisive sentence and a readable opener. Forms: F1 plain polar, F2 alternative, F3 or-not, F4 negative interrogative.
blocks.zh: 表7:法官审计和开业保险。 审计间隔为95%;每套测试测试程序在300个否定式询问是/不是第一次答复上重复法官,每个语言50个,在参考命题和相反之处有1个和3个翻转。 本地读者的标签同意93.0%的Astra标签和95.4%的Fable标签,没有任何决定性的读者标签反对决定性的机器标签。 上层集团与首席法官达成一致,同意两位法官所坚持的相反的决定性主张(“对面”)的答复数量;经审计的否定式讯问是/不是第一次答复,每份语文为19-33份。 Core-strata块重新判断,在高推理努力下有三个Claude法官配置,一个原始的答案样本,固定规则和主句标签既是决定性的,是按型号×\times语言单元格绘制的,也是按两种读数是否一致或冲突来划分的;同意主标,因此在冲突行上,是审计法官坚持句子与固定规则相对应的答复比例. 在所有经审计的答复中,其余的分歧在决定性的类别和未决定的类别之间(Astra为134和42;Fable为47和54)或两个未决定的类别之间(19和15)提出答复。 覆盖范围包括所显示的三个限制因素,不包括一个13 824个完整的控制层。 可读性通过生成的回复将可读打开器分隔开来. 扩展修改了判词规则;替代质询粒子在设计上是无法读取的. 两者都要求有决定性的句子和可读的开口语. 形式:F1平原极,F2替代,F3或-,F4负式审讯.
